name: Coppelia, Arui wa Itsuwari no Otome
original_name: コッペリア、あるいは偽りの乙女
source:
There were three doll maidens in the puppet theater, Lapin.
Whilst holding dreams of being loved by someone, they each set out on their own destinies.

[Translated from [url=https://nohana-no3.jimdofree.com/2018/05/08/original-game-コッペリア-あるいは偽りの乙女]official website[/url]]
